⟦{彼女|かのじょ}→彼女：01286_kanojo⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{化粧|けしょう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{濃|こ}い→濃い：02344_koi⟧。

examples.english: I put on makeup in front of the mirror in the morning.

examples.japanese: ⟦{友達|ともだち}→友達：01478_tomodachi⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{会|あ}う→会う：00482_au⟧⟦{前|まえ}→前：02255_mae⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{化粧|けしょう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{直|なお}した→直す：00869_naosu⟧。⟦{特|とく}に→特に：01260_tokuni⟧⟦{口紅|くちべに}→口紅：00249_kuchibeni⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{取|と}れていた→取れる：02376_toreru⟧⟦ので→ので：09501_node⟧、⟦{塗|ぬ}り{直|なお}した→塗る：01174_nuru⟧。
examples.english: I fixed my makeup before meeting my friend. My lipstick had come off, so I reapplied it.

notes:
{化粧|けしょう} refers to makeup or cosmetics, and also functions as a する verb meaning to apply makeup.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {化粧|けしょう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to apply/put on makeup
- {化粧|けしょう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{落|お}とす→落とす：01246_otosu⟧: to remove makeup
- ⟦{薄化粧|うすげしょう}→薄化粧：16437_usugeshou⟧: light/minimal makeup
- ⟦{厚化粧|あつげしょう}→厚化粧：16415_atsugeshou⟧: heavy makeup

COMPOUNDS:
- ⟦{化粧品|けしょうひん}→化粧品：05119_keshouhin⟧: cosmetics, beauty products
- ⟦{化粧室|けしょうしつ}→化粧室：15885_keshoushitsu⟧: restroom (euphemism, literally "powder room")
- ⟦{化粧水|けしょうすい}→化粧水：15802_keshousui⟧: facial toner/lotion
- {化粧|けしょう}⟦ポーチ→ポーチ：09488_poochi⟧: makeup pouch

RELATED WORDS:
⟦メイク→メイク：11163_meiku⟧ (from English "make[up]") is commonly used as a casual synonym, especially among younger speakers: ⟦メイク→メイク：11163_meiku⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (to do makeup).
